"ZOOM! (but turning) (but also wide)"


The Wide Corner Conveyor is a structure that can be purchased from The Oak Depot. It is a wider version of Corner Conveyor.

Functionality

While otherwise identical to a Corner Conveyor, the Wide Corner Conveyor can also serve the unique purpose of an adaptor to go between wide sections of conveyor belts and standard width conveyor belts. This is useful for dealing with late-game resources which tend to require the use of wide conveyor belts to avoid jamming.
